before.alt: Prompt tab: a bare 'First message' field under the system prompt

Whether callers can interrupt the greeting is buried in Advanced JSON (greeting_configs.interruptable), invisible on the tab where the greeting is written.
Silence handling lives on another tab with no recap here, and the caller never gets to hear the composed opening before go-live.

before.alt: Advanced tab: the 'Filler Words' row in engineering words
wrong: Engineering vocabulary ('Filler Words', 'response wait ms', 'selection rule') where the user thinks 'while thinking, say…'.
Shipped controls and Requires-Engine ideas (persona filler, continue after filler, tool-call filler) are not told apart, so reviewers ask for things the Engine cannot do yet.

learnings: LiveKit gates every latency view behind a free Observability toggle; once on, the Agents page gains Response Latency 'tails by stage' and Interrupted Rate — stage-level latency is the norm (sip-agents-observability-panels).

Retell puts the Disconnection Reason next to End-to-End latency in the call's analysis block and exposes per-turn E2E latency only as log lines — nobody attributes latency per leg (carrier vs platform vs model) (sip-call-detail-*).
Retell's analytics default range renders all-zero KPIs with no empty state, so 0 ms reads as 'fine'; our empty states must say 'no calls in range' (sip-analytics-empty-default-range).

LiveKit's Telephony page has a 'Calls with issues' panel and SIP trunks as first-class objects; the inbound trunk form carries SRTP, headers and Krisp (sip-telephony-calls-empty, sip-trunk-inbound-form).

Whitespace: no vendor draws a signalling ladder or names the responsible party. SW4Y4M's verdict + 'Attributed to' is ahead of the market — it needs time on the ladder and a fix per verdict to become the diagnostic.

before.source: SW4Y4M branch design/sip-diagnostics-prototype — Call Details › SIP Trace (success)
before.alt: Verdict banner, KPI row, four-lane signalling ladder
wrong: The summary contradicts the verdict: 'Agent completed the call' sits above Call outcome 'Failed' and end reason 'Call rejected'. The KPI row must be derived from the same verdict.
The ladder has no time: no per-hop timestamps and no latency per leg (agent → gateway → trunk → phone), so 'why was it slow' cannot be answered here; Latency is a separate tab.
'Certain cause' is a label, not evidence — it should point at the hop that decided the verdict.

before.alt: 'Call rate limit exceeded' verdict, Quota limit badge, repeated INVITE → 503 cycles
wrong: The verdict explains what happened (14 calls against 10/s) but not the fix: no link to the CPS limit, the campaign pacing, or the Retry-After guidance.
Three identical INVITE → 503 → ACK cycles are drawn in full; repeats should collapse into one row with a count so the ladder fits one screen.
Only this state highlights the failing hop; every state should mark the deciding message.

before.source: SW4Y4M branch — SIP Trace (no trace retained)
before.alt: 'Cause could not be determined' with an empty ladder
wrong: 'No signalling trace was retained' gives no way forward — no retention setting, no trace id for support, no pointer to the Events tab.
Uncertain outcomes reuse the certain-cause layout; 'we don't know' needs its own weight and a next step.

directions: A · Verdict with the fix — verdict, attributed-to and one action (raise CPS, check the trunk allow-list, send the trace id to support)
B · Timed ladder — per-hop timestamps, latency per leg summarised above the ladder, repeated cycles collapsed with a count
C · Issues first — Call History filtered to calls with issues, grouped by attributed-to with counts (LiveKit's panel, done properly)
D · Latency tails by stage — per-agent chart linking to the calls in the tail (LiveKit pattern; needs Engine stage timings)
E · Raw SIP only — message list and headers, no verdict (rejected: pushes the diagnosis onto the user)
rows.verdict: Verdict — A + B on the call page (the verdict drives the KPI row; the ladder gets time and per-leg latency; every verdict names its fix), C on the list; D once Engine payloads carry stage timings; E rejected.
